why: The stable-lad says three of the sheep have gone lame.

text: In the weeks before the crime
why: The lad only says 'of late'. Nothing places the laming in the weeks before the crime.
Holmes's pointed question and the lad's answer naturally raise this question.

text: What lamed the sheep? — an epidemic or chance
why: Ordinary illness or accident is a plain, neutral explanation any reader could consider.

text: What lamed the sheep? — someone practised on them
why: Nothing yet suggests anyone deliberately practised on the sheep. This points at an unrevealed solution.
